transcript: Speaker A: I yawn. Yawn means opening my mouth when I feel sleepy. I stretch. Stretch means moving my body to relax. I relax. Relax means feeling calm. I rest. Rest means relaxing my body. I snooze. Snooze means sleeping a little more. I take a nap. Nap means a short sleep. I lie down. Lie down means putting my body on the bed. I wake up. Wake up means opening my eyes after sleep.
